tagline: Mirror your folders to Google Drive on your own schedule, without using extra disk space and within your data limits.
manual_only: Only when you click Sync now
st_setup_needed_d: This copy of Selva Sync needs a Google API Client ID before it can connect.
st_not_signed_in_d: Connect your Google Drive to start.
st_no_folders_d: Choose the folders you want to mirror to Google Drive.
st_ready_d: Click Sync now for the first sync, or wait for the schedule.
st_partial_d: {n} files could not be uploaded. See Activity for details. They will be tried again next time.
st_cap_d: Some files are waiting. They will upload next month, or raise the limit in Data & Internet.
st_stopped_d: The last sync was stopped. It will continue next time.
st_signin_d: Your Google sign-in has expired or was removed. Go to Settings and connect again.
st_full_d: Free up space in Google Drive or buy more storage, then sync again.
st_failed_d: Probably no internet connection. Selva Sync will try again automatically.
ph_scan: Looking for new and changed files
setup_google_d: This copy of Selva Sync was built without a Google API Client ID. Create a free one in Google Cloud Console (see the guide that came with Selva Sync) and paste it in Settings › Advanced.
welcome_d: Three quick steps and your folders will be safely mirrored to Google Drive.
step_folders: Choose folders or drives to mirror
step_schedule: Pick a schedule and data limit (optional)
connect_privacy: Selva Sync can only see the files it creates. It cannot read anything else in your Google Drive.
folders_intro: Pick any folders or whole drives (C:, D:, USB drives). Only new and changed files are uploaded. Nothing is copied on this computer, so no extra disk space is used.
no_folders_yet: No folders yet. Click Add folder.
remove_folder_d: Stop mirroring {path}? Files already on Google Drive stay there.
exclude_intro: One rule per line. * matches anything (example: *.iso skips all ISO files). A rule starting with / only applies from the top of a drive (example: /Windows skips C:\Windows but not D:\Clients\Windows). Windows system folders and temporary files are skipped by default.
no_subfolders: No subfolders here. You can select this folder.
pick_hint: Open a drive or folder, then click Select this folder.
already_added: This folder is already in the list.
inside_other: This folder is already included in {path}.
whole_drive_d: Windows and program folders are skipped automatically, but a whole drive can still be very large. Check that your Google Drive has enough space. Use Preview changes to see the size before the first sync.
schedule_intro: Choose when Selva Sync checks for changes and uploads them.
sched_manual_d: Only when I click Sync now.
sync_on_startup: Also sync when the computer starts
sync_on_startup_d: Runs about 2 minutes after Windows starts.
start_with_windows_d: Needed for scheduled syncs. Selva Sync waits quietly in the notification area.
missed_runs_note: If the computer was off at the scheduled time, the sync runs as soon as it is back on.
internet_intro: Keep Selva Sync from using all your internet or mobile data.
speed_hint: At most about {gb} GB per hour
cap_label: Stop uploading after this much data each month
cap_hint: 0 means no limit. Counting restarts on the 1st of every month.
pause_metered_d: Mobile data, phone hotspots and Wi-Fi networks you marked as metered in Windows.
blocked_wifi: Never sync on these Wi-Fi networks
allowed_wifi: Only sync on these Wi-Fi networks
allowed_wifi_d: Leave empty to allow all. Wired connections are always allowed.
no_wifi_now: Not connected to Wi-Fi right now.
parallel: Files uploaded at the same time
parallel_d: More is faster on good connections. Use 1 or 2 on slow internet.
safety_intro: Decide what happens on Google Drive when files change or are deleted on this computer.
deleted_title: When a file is deleted on this computer
del_archive: Move it to the archive on Drive (recommended)
del_archive_d: It goes to the "Archive (Selva Sync)" folder, sorted by date. Protects you from accidental deletion.
del_keep_d: Drive keeps everything that was ever uploaded.
del_trash_d: Moved to the Google Drive trash, where it can be restored for 30 days.
archive_days_d: After this many days, archived files are deleted permanently. 0 = keep forever.
keep_versions: Keep a copy of the old version when a file changes
keep_versions_d: The copy is made inside Google Drive, so it uses no internet data, but it uses Drive storage. Google Drive also keeps its own version history for 30 days.
drive_names_d: Each computer gets its own folder, so several PCs can share one Google account.
full_check_d: If files were deleted directly in Google Drive, this finds them and uploads them again. It also runs automatically once a month.
add_language_d: Add your own language: copy en.json into the languages folder, translate the text and save it as your language code (for example de.json).
notifications_d: A short message when a sync finishes or needs attention.
permission_note: Permission given: only files and folders created by Selva Sync. Your sign-in is encrypted with Windows and stored only on this computer.
sign_out_d: Disconnect Google Drive from Selva Sync on this computer? Your files on Drive are not deleted.
advanced_d: Selva Sync connects to Google with an OAuth Client ID (type: Desktop app). You can use your own from Google Cloud Console. Leave empty to use the one built into this copy.
advanced_note: Required API: Google Drive API. Required scope: .../auth/drive.file only.
creds_change_d: Changing the Client ID signs you out. You will need to connect Google Drive again.
data_folder: Settings and logs are stored in:
privacy_1: No registration, no account with us, no ads.
privacy_2: No data collection, analytics or tracking of any kind.
privacy_3: Your files go only from your computer straight to your own Google Drive.
privacy_4: Selva Sync can only see files it created. It cannot read the rest of your Drive.
privacy_5: Your Google sign-in is encrypted with Windows and never leaves this computer.
privacy_6: Open source: anyone can check exactly what the program does.
uninstall_d: Removes Selva Sync from this computer. Files already on Google Drive stay there.
uninstall_data: Also delete settings, logs and sign-in from this computer
uninstall_confirm: Remove Selva Sync from this computer now?
uninstall_done: Selva Sync has been removed. You can close this window.
quit_d: Scheduled syncs will not run until Selva Sync is started again.
pv_nothing: Everything is already up to date.
pv_more: Only the first 1000 items are shown.
signin_browser: Continue in your browser to sign in to Google.
signin_ok_text: Selva Sync is now connected to your Google Drive. You can close this tab and return to Selva Sync.
signin_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Return to Selva Sync and try again.
err_no_folders: Please add at least one folder first.
err_no_client: No Google Client ID is set. See Settings › Advanced.
reason_metered: Waiting: you are on a metered connection (mobile data or hotspot).
reason_wifi_blocked: Waiting: syncing is turned off for this Wi-Fi network.
reason_wifi_not_allowed: Waiting: this Wi-Fi network is not in your allowed list.
log_run_end: Sync finished: {result}. New {uploaded}, changed {updated}, archived {archived}, failed {failed}, sent {bytes}
log_source_nested: Skipped because it is inside another selected folder: {path}
log_cap_reached: Monthly data limit reached. Remaining files will upload next month or when you raise the limit.
log_full_check: Checking the Drive copy for missing files
log_signin_needed: Google sign-in expired. Please sign in again.
log_nothing: Everything is already up to date.
notify_partial: Sync finished, but {failed} files could not be uploaded.
notify_cap: Monthly data limit reached. Some files are waiting.
notify_signin: Please open Selva Sync and sign in to Google again.
notify_full: Your Google Drive is full. Sync could not finish.
notify_failed: Sync failed. Selva Sync will try again later.
log_version_failed: Old version could not be saved in the archive: {path}
log_source_new_drive: This drive is a different disk than before, so it was skipped to protect the first disk's backup. If you replaced the disk, remove the folder and add it again: {path}
log_relocated: Put back in its place on Drive: {path}
log_restored_from_trash: {n} files that were deleted on Google Drive will be uploaded again
log_source_duplicate: Skipped because another selected folder already uses the same place on Drive: {path}
log_settings_recovered: Your settings file was damaged. The last good copy was restored.
log_settings_reset: Your settings file was damaged and no backup was found. Please check your folders and schedule.
reason_wifi_unknown: Waiting: Windows does not share the Wi-Fi name with apps. Turn on Location in Windows Settings, or empty the 'Only sync on these Wi-Fi networks' list.
reason_other_instance: Another copy of Selva Sync is already syncing on this computer.
settings_recovered_d: Your settings file was damaged (for example by a power cut). Selva Sync restored the last good copy. Please check that your folders and schedule are correct.
settings_reset_d: Your settings file was damaged and no backup was found, so default settings are being used. Please add your folders again and check the schedule. The damaged file was kept in the settings folder.
err_offline: Selva Sync is not responding. It may have been closed. Open it again from the Start menu.
preview_stopped: The preview was stopped before it finished.
net_wifi_hidden: Wi-Fi name hidden by Windows (turn on Location to use Wi-Fi rules)
signin_expired: This sign-in link is not valid any more. Return to Selva Sync and click Connect Google Drive again.
msg_update_confirm: Update Selva Sync from version {old} to {new}?
msg_downgrade_confirm: Version {old} of Selva Sync is installed. Replace it with the OLDER version {new}?
msg_reinstall_confirm: Selva Sync {new} is already installed, but this file is different. Replace the installed copy with this one?
msg_uninstall_confirm:
Remove Selva Sync from this computer?

Your files on Google Drive will NOT be deleted.
msg_uninstall_data: Also delete Selva Sync settings and sign-in from this computer?
msg_uninstall_done: Selva Sync will now be removed. Your files on Google Drive are not affected.
signin_busy: Selva Sync is still stopping the current sync. Wait a minute, then click Connect Google Drive again.
signin_failed_d: Google did not accept the sign-in. Please return to Selva Sync and try again.
use_disk_d: The disk at {path} is not the one Selva Sync backed up before. Use it from now on? Only do this if you replaced the disk or moved your files to it.
only_on_ac: Only sync when the laptop is charging
only_on_ac_d: On battery, Selva Sync waits until you plug in. Desktop PCs are not affected.
alert_days: Warn me if there has been no successful backup for
alert_days_d: The tray icon turns red and you get a notification. 0 turns the reminder off.
location_d: All backups from this PC are saved inside this one folder. It can be in My Drive or in a shared drive.
reports_d: At the start of each month, a short text report of last month's backups is saved in the backup folder on Drive.
managed_notice: Some settings are set by your organisation and cannot be changed here.
picker_url_d: Web address of the page that shows Google's folder chooser. Only needed if your publisher gave you one.
office_d: Save these settings as selvasync-setup.json. Put it next to SelvaSync.exe on other PCs and they start with the same settings. See the user guide to lock settings.
location_managed: Your organisation has chosen this folder.
location_no_picker: Choosing another folder is not set up in this copy of Selva Sync, so backups go to My Drive › Selva Sync.
location_sign_in_first: Connect Google Drive first, then choose the folder.
st_location_d: The chosen Google Drive folder was deleted, moved to the bin, or you no longer have access. Nothing was uploaded anywhere else. Choose the folder again.
overdue_d: Your files have not been backed up for a while. Check the internet connection, then click Sync now.
pv_space: About {need} to upload. Free space on your Google Drive: {free}.
pv_space_low: This is more than the free space. Remove some folders or free up space on Google Drive first.
location_pick_d: Your browser will open Google's folder chooser. Sign in with the same Google account and choose the folder for all backups from this PC.
location_change_d: Your browser will open Google's folder chooser. If you choose a different folder, the next sync uploads everything again into the new folder. Nothing in the old folder is deleted.
picker_browser: Choose the folder in your browser, then come back here.
location_default_d: Backups will go to My Drive › Selva Sync again. The next sync uploads everything into that folder. Nothing in the current folder is deleted.
err_managed: This setting is set by your organisation.
err_no_picker: Choosing a folder is not set up in this copy of Selva Sync.
picked_expired: This link has expired. Click 'Choose folder in Google Drive' in Selva Sync again.
picked_cancelled: No folder was chosen. You can close this tab.
picked_bad: Something went wrong. Please try again from Selva Sync.
picked_no_access: Selva Sync cannot open this folder. Make sure you chose it with the same Google account that is connected in Selva Sync.
picked_net: Could not reach Google Drive. Check the internet connection and try again.
picked_not_folder: Please choose a folder, not a file.
picked_read_only: You can only view this folder. Choose a folder where you can add files.
picked_ok_text: Backups from this PC will be saved in: {name}. You can close this tab.
notify_overdue: No successful backup for {days} days. Open Selva Sync to check.
notify_location: The Google Drive backup folder is not available. Open Selva Sync and choose it again.
reason_on_battery: Waiting: the laptop is on battery. Plug in the charger to sync.
log_location_missing: The chosen Google Drive backup folder is missing or you no longer have access to it. Nothing was uploaded. Choose the folder again.
picked_inside: This folder is inside a Selva Sync backup folder. Choose a folder outside it (for example the folder that contains "Selva Sync").
picked_wrong_managed: Please choose your organisation's backup folder: {name}
picked_granted: Selva Sync can now use your organisation's backup folder ({name}). You can close this tab.
location_managed_grant: Your organisation chose this folder. If backups say it is not available, click the button and choose this same folder in Google Drive once.
st_location_inside_d: The chosen folder is inside a Selva Sync backup, where it could be archived by mistake. Nothing was uploaded. Choose a different folder.
log_location_inside: The chosen Google Drive folder is inside a Selva Sync backup folder. Nothing was uploaded. Choose a different folder.
log_location_granted: Access given to the organisation's backup folder: {name}
log_setup_problem: The office setup file (selvasync-setup.json) has mistakes. Not used: {keys}
setup_problem: The office setup file has settings that could not be read and were not used: {keys}
whole_pc_hint: Adds every internal drive (C:, D:...) in one click. Windows, programs and temporary files are skipped automatically.
whole_pc_d: These drives will be backed up: {drives}. Windows, Program Files, ProgramData, AppData, the Recycle Bin and temporary files are skipped automatically. Folders you added inside these drives are replaced by the whole drive (no duplicates). A whole computer can be large: the size and your free Google Drive space are shown before anything is uploaded.
whole_pc_added: Added {drives}. Check the size before the first sync.
cloud_files: Also back up OneDrive files that are only online
cloud_files_d: Files with the cloud icon are downloaded one at a time for the backup and made online-only again right after, so no disk space stays in use. This uses internet data for the download as well as the upload.
msg_install_confirm:
Install Selva Sync {new} for your Windows user?

It will copy itself to your user's Programs folder, add a Start menu shortcut and an entry in "Apps", and start with Windows (you can turn this off in Schedule). No administrator rights are needed. Uninstall any time from Windows Settings > Apps.
